title: Property Alias Master Register
sourceText:
PROPERTY MANAGEMENT - PROPERTY ALIAS MASTER REGISTER. This register is the single source of truth for resolving property names, English/Chinese variants, and short codes used across operations systems. Operations staff MUST resolve every incident, work permit, and roster entry against this register before routing.

ENTRY 1. Canonical: YOHO Mall. Aliases: 形點, YOHO MALL I, YOHO MALL II, Yuen Long YOHO. Segment: shopping_mall. Region: Yuen Long, New Territories. Note: 形點 is the official Chinese name of YOHO Mall - they are the SAME property. Linked estate: Grand YOHO.

ENTRY 2. Canonical: ICC. Aliases: International Commerce Centre, 環球貿易廣場, ICC Tower, West Kowloon ICC. Segment: office_tower. Region: West Kowloon. Note: 環球貿易廣場 is the official Chinese name of ICC.

ENTRY 3. Canonical: MOKO. Aliases: MOKO 新世紀廣場, New Century Plaza, Mongkok MOKO. Segment: shopping_mall. Region: Mong Kok, Kowloon.

ENTRY 4. Canonical: MegaBox. Aliases: 企業廣場, MegaBox Kowloon Bay, Enterprise Square Five. Segment: shopping_mall. Region: Kowloon Bay.

ENTRY 5. Canonical: Metro City. Aliases: 新都城, Metro City Plaza, Tseung Kwan O Metro City. Segment: shopping_mall. Region: Tseung Kwan O, New Territories.

ENTRY 6. Canonical: Grand YOHO. Aliases: Grand YOHO Phase 1, Grand YOHO Phase 2. Segment: residential_estate. Region: Yuen Long. Note: residential development adjacent to YOHO Mall / 形點.

ENTRY 7. Canonical: 珀麗灣 (Park Island). Aliases: Park Island, PI. Segment: residential_estate. Region: Ma Wan.

ENTRY 8. Canonical: Double Cove. Aliases: 迎海, Wu Kai Sha Double Cove. Segment: residential_estate. Region: Ma On Shan, New Territories.

ENTRY 9. Canonical: The Henderson. Aliases: 恒地中心, 2 Murray Road. Segment: office_tower. Region: Central.

title: YOHO Mall / 形點 Alias Fact Sheet
sourceText: ALIAS FACT SHEET - YOHO Mall. Confirmed identity: YOHO Mall and 形點 are the SAME property. 形點 is the official Chinese-language name used in tenant signage, marketing, and government correspondence. YOHO Mall comprises YOHO MALL I and YOHO MALL II connected by a footbridge. Located in Yuen Long, New Territories, adjacent to the Grand YOHO residential development. Any incident, SOP, or work permit referencing 形點 should be treated as referencing YOHO Mall, and vice versa. Common confusion: do NOT confuse YOHO Mall (shopping mall) with Grand YOHO (residential estate) - they are neighbouring but distinct properties under shared estate management.
chunkText: YOHO Mall and 形點 are the SAME property. 形點 is the official Chinese name. YOHO Mall = YOHO MALL I + YOHO MALL II in Yuen Long, adjacent to Grand YOHO residential estate. Treat any reference to 形點 as YOHO Mall. Do not confuse YOHO Mall (mall) with Grand YOHO (residence).

title: Incident Report - Water Leakage Escalation at Grand YOHO Tower 3

extractedFields.resolution: Isolated riser, dispatched plumber, dehumidifiers deployed

sourceText: INCIDENT REPORT INC-GY-2024-0312. Property: Grand YOHO Tower 3. Location: 28/F common corridor and Flat E. Reported: 2024-03-12 23:47 by night security to Estate Control Room (ext 2888). Nature: water leakage from ceiling, suspected chilled water riser failure on 29/F. Actions: (1) Control Room notified on-call technician at 23:49. (2) Duty Manager Wong Mei Ling acknowledged at 23:55 (within 15 minutes per SOP-WATER-RES). (3) On-call technician isolated the affected riser valve at 00:18 and stopped active leakage. (4) Escalated to building services contractor for riser repair; emergency plumber attended 01:40. (5) Two dehumidifiers deployed in corridor and Flat E. (6) Affected resident relocated to guest suite overnight. Escalation timeline met SOP-WATER-RES targets: acknowledgement <15 min, on-site mitigation <30 min. Follow-up: chilled water riser on 29/F scheduled for inspection. Lessons: confirm riser isolation valve labelling on Tower 3.

title: Incident Report - Chilled Water / HVAC Complaint at ICC Office Tower

extractedFields.resolution: Reset AHU, restored chilled water valve actuator

sourceText: INCIDENT REPORT INC-ICC-2024-0521. Property: ICC / 環球貿易廣場. Location: 73/F, Zone 4 office floor. Reported: 2024-05-21 14:10 by tenant facilities rep. Nature: HVAC complaint - office floor too warm, suspected chilled water supply issue. Investigation: BMS showed Zone 4 Air Handling Unit (AHU-4) chilled water valve actuator stuck at 20% open. Duty Manager Peter Chan coordinated with the building services contractor. Actions: (1) AHU-4 reset and chilled water valve actuator manually exercised at 15:05. (2) Supply air temperature restored to setpoint by 15:40. (3) Tenant notified of resolution. HVAC chilled water complaint handling for ICC follows SOP-HVAC-OFFICE: verify BMS alarms, check AHU and chilled water valves, engage building services contractor, confirm restoration with tenant. Follow-up: schedule actuator replacement for AHU-4.

title: SOP - Overnight Contractor Access for YOHO Mall Fitting-Out Works
sourceText:
STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE SOP-YOHO-ACCESS-001 - OVERNIGHT CONTRACTOR ACCESS FOR YOHO MALL FITTING-OUT WORKS. Applies to: YOHO Mall / 形點 (YOHO MALL I and II). Purpose: govern overnight contractor access for tenant fitting-out works outside mall trading hours.

1. PERMIT REQUIREMENT. All overnight fitting-out works require an approved Overnight Work Permit submitted at least 48 hours in advance. Hot works additionally require a Hot Work Permit. Overnight works DO require management approval - no exceptions.

2. WORKING HOURS. Overnight contractor access window is 23:00 to 07:00. No noisy works before mall closing.

3. ACCESS & ESCORT. Contractors enter via the YOHO MALL I loading bay. Security verifies the Overnight Work Permit and worker IDs against the approved list. Overnight contractor liaison: Peter Chan (陳大文).

4. LOADING BAY. Material delivery uses the loading bay with pre-booked slots; no loading bay use without booking.

5. FIRE & SAFETY. Fire services impairment must be logged; standby fire watch required for hot works.

6. COMPLETION. Site cleared and handed back by 07:00; permit closed with security. This procedure is the authoritative overnight contractor access procedure for YOHO Mall fitting-out works.

title: SOP - Emergency Water Seepage & Leakage Handling for Residential Estates
sourceText:
STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE SOP-WATER-RES-001 - EMERGENCY WATER SEEPAGE & LEAKAGE HANDLING FOR RESIDENTIAL ESTATES. Applies to: Grand YOHO, 珀麗灣 (Park Island), Double Cove (迎海) and other managed residential estates.

ESCALATION PROCESS FOR WATER LEAKAGE:
1. REPORT. Any water leakage or seepage is reported to the Estate Control Room (24/7). For Grand YOHO this is ext 2888.
2. NOTIFY. Control Room immediately notifies the on-call technician AND the Estate Duty Manager. Water leakage is classified as urgent.
3. ACKNOWLEDGE. The Duty Manager must acknowledge within 15 minutes.
4. MITIGATE. On-call technician attends and performs first mitigation within 30 minutes: identify source, isolate the affected water or chilled water riser, stop active leakage.
5. ESCALATE. If the source is a riser or structural failure, escalate to the building services contractor / emergency plumber. Relocate affected residents if a unit is uninhabitable.
6. RECORD. Log the incident, actions, and timeline. This is the escalation process for water leakage at residential estates including Grand YOHO.

Escalation process for water leakage: 1) Report to Estate Control Room 24/7 (Grand YOHO ext 2888). 2) Control Room notifies on-call technician and Estate Duty Manager; water leakage is urgent. 3) Duty Manager acknowledges within 15 minutes. 4) Technician mitigates within 30 minutes: identify source, isolate affected riser, stop leakage. 5) Escalate riser/structural failures to building services contractor / emergency plumber; relocate residents if needed. 6) Record incident and timeline. This is the escalation process for water leakage at Grand YOHO.

title: SOP - HVAC & Chilled Water Complaint Handling for Office Towers

extractedFields.appliesTo: ICC, The Henderson and other office towers

sourceText:
STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE SOP-HVAC-OFFICE-001 - HVAC & CHILLED WATER COMPLAINT HANDLING FOR OFFICE TOWERS. Applies to: ICC / 環球貿易廣場, The Henderson and other managed office towers. Purpose: handle tenant HVAC complaints such as floors too warm or too cold, poor air, or chilled water supply issues.

HVAC COMPLAINT HANDLING STEPS:
1. LOG. Record the HVAC complaint with floor, zone, and reported temperature.
2. VERIFY BMS. Check the Building Management System (BMS) for alarms on the affected zone Air Handling Unit (AHU) and chilled water plant.
3. INSPECT. Inspect the zone AHU, chilled water valves and actuators; exercise or reset stuck actuators.
4. ENGAGE CONTRACTOR. If plant or valve faults persist, engage the building services contractor.
5. RESTORE & CONFIRM. Restore supply air temperature to setpoint and confirm resolution with the tenant within 30 minutes where possible.
6. FOLLOW-UP. Raise corrective maintenance for faulty actuators or valves. This is the HVAC chilled water complaint handling procedure for ICC / 環球貿易廣場.

title: SOP - Mall Event Permit & Loading Arrangement Procedure
sourceText:
STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE SOP-EVENT-MALL-001 - MALL EVENT PERMIT & LOADING ARRANGEMENT PROCEDURE. Applies to: MegaBox / 企業廣場, MOKO, YOHO Mall / 形點, Metro City / 新都城 and other managed malls.

1. EVENT PERMIT. Atrium or promotional events require an approved Event Permit submitted at least 5 working days in advance, with layout, schedule, and contractor list.
2. CONTRACTOR ACCESS. Event contractors must be registered; contractor access during build-up uses designated routes and the service lift, not customer areas.
3. LOADING BAY ARRANGEMENT. All event deliveries require pre-booked loading bay slots. A marshalling plan staggers truck arrivals to prevent loading bay congestion. Tenant deliveries retain priority windows.
4. BUILD-UP HOURS. Heavy build-up outside trading hours where practical.
5. SAFETY. Fire egress and exit routes must remain clear; fire services impairment logged.
6. DISMANTLING. Loading bay slots also pre-booked for dismantling. This procedure covers both contractor access and loading bay arrangements for mall events.

title: SOP - Resident & Tenant Complaint Escalation Workflow
sourceText: STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE SOP-COMPLAINT-ESC-001 - RESIDENT & TENANT COMPLAINT ESCALATION WORKFLOW. Three-tier escalation: TIER 1 frontline/customer service acknowledges and attempts resolution within 1 working day. TIER 2 if unresolved or urgent, escalate to the property Duty Manager, who owns urgent operational complaints (water, lift, HVAC, security) immediately. TIER 3 sensitive, repeat, or high-impact complaints escalate to the Property Manager and Group Operations, with service recovery actions. Urgent safety complaints bypass tiers and go straight to the Duty Manager and, after hours, the Control Room. All complaints logged with category, property, and resolution.

title: FAQ - After-Hours Contacts & Emergency Maintenance

extractedFields.afterHoursDefinition: After 18:00 and before 09:00, weekends, public holidays

sourceText:
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS - AFTER-HOURS & EMERGENCY MAINTENANCE.

Q: Who do I contact after hours? A: Contact your property's Estate Control Room or Management Office hotline. After-hours means after 18:00 and before 09:00, plus weekends and public holidays. The Control Room dispatches the on-call technician and notifies the Duty Manager. For Grand YOHO the Control Room is ext 2888.

Q: What qualifies as emergency / urgent maintenance? A: Water leakage, lift entrapment or outage, power loss, gas smell, fire safety system faults, and security threats are urgent and handled immediately. Non-urgent issues are logged for next working day.

Q: How fast will someone respond? A: For urgent items the Duty Manager acknowledges within 15 minutes and first mitigation is targeted within 30 minutes.

Q: 誰是緊急聯絡人? A: 請聯絡屋苑控制中心熱線。緊急維修包括漏水、電梯故障、停電等，會即時處理。

Who to contact after hours: your property's Estate Control Room / Management Office hotline (Grand YOHO ext 2888); after-hours = after 18:00 and before 09:00, weekends, public holidays; Control Room dispatches on-call technician and notifies Duty Manager. Emergency/urgent maintenance: water leakage, lift entrapment/outage, power loss, gas smell, fire safety faults, security threats - handled immediately. Urgent response: Duty Manager acknowledges within 15 minutes, mitigation within 30 minutes.

title: FAQ - Fitting-Out Permit & Overnight Works (Bilingual)
sourceText:
FAQ - FITTING-OUT PERMIT & OVERNIGHT WORKS (BILINGUAL).

Q: Do overnight works need approval? A: YES. All overnight fitting-out works require management approval and an approved Overnight Work Permit submitted at least 48 hours in advance. For YOHO Mall / 形點 see SOP-YOHO-ACCESS-001.

Q: What is a fitting-out permit? A: A Fitting-Out Permit authorises tenant renovation/fit-out works in a leased unit, covering scope, contractors, hours, and safety conditions.

Q: 裝修工程需要許可嗎? A: 需要。所有租戶裝修工程須申請裝修許可（Fitting-Out Permit）。通宵工程另須管理處批准及通宵工程許可證，最少48小時前提交。形點 (YOHO Mall) 的通宵承辦商進場安排請參閱 SOP-YOHO-ACCESS-001。

Q: Can contractors work during mall trading hours? A: Noisy or hazardous works are restricted to the overnight window 23:00-07:00 for YOHO Mall.

title: Contractor Access & Site Induction Procedure
sourceText: CONTRACTOR ACCESS & SITE INDUCTION PROCEDURE. 1. REGISTRATION. All contractors register with the Management Office and complete a site induction (valid 12 months) before first access. 2. ACCESS CONTROL. Contractors are issued temporary access cards; access is limited to permitted areas and the relevant loading bay. 3. PERMIT TO WORK. Hot works, work at height, confined space, and electrical isolation require a specific Permit to Work in addition to any Overnight or Fitting-Out Permit. 4. PPE & SAFETY. Mandatory PPE; comply with site safety rules and fire egress. 5. LOADING BAY. Material handling via the assigned loading bay with pre-booked slots. 6. SIGN-OUT. Contractors sign out and return access cards on completion. Covers contractor access and loading bay arrangements across malls, office towers, and estates.
